production_gate: native-package-verification.json confirms package and bounded actual compiled reviews passed; no exact device acceptance
question: Can exact matched regular stock-equivalent View2D dispatch carry a private scalar to refuse only physical ordinary Pencil PAN at native invocation after actual successful poll and before operator allocation?
conclusion: Yes as a bounded explicit navigation policy, conditional on complete profile and transport contracts and a callback-free eligible corridor. Return OPERATOR_CANCELLED alone immediately inside successful WM_operator_poll branch before CTX manager/id snapshots and wm_operator_create. This is source-contract review only; no proposed guard exists in production and no native test execution is claimed.
exact_contract: Only wm_handlers_do_keymap_with_keymap_handler can create private enum None/StockPan/StockCtrlZoom after actual native WM_keymap_poll and wm_eventmatch. No field/receipt is placed on wmEvent, window, context, keymap, operator, or handler.

Require actual current region handlers, static native default View2D handler, no handler flags/poll, dynamic getter, post callback/user_data, keymap_tool, and exact canonical full25-item default/effective raw profile as independently reviewed by dispatch-contract agent.

Pass scalar only as stack arguments along this regular call to wm_handler_operator_call then wm_operator_invoke. All explicit, delegated, gizmo, modal, macro, simulation and other call sites remain None by default. Do not derive eligibility from an operator name inside the general invoke function.

Before actual WM_operator_poll, require positive current physical ordinary Pencil PAN metadata and exact type/value/modifier/keymodifier/domain for scalar kind. Reject active CTX_py_dict_get(C), then use native Node WINDOW context. No stored raw pointer is a new lifetime guarantee.

Require actual resolved native operator identity in view2d_ops.cc with a narrow pure same-TU helper. Compare native poll/exec/invoke/modal/cancel callbacks, expected blocking/grab flags, absent pyop_poll/RNA extension and empty macro list. Exact registry lookup/name alone is insufficient for broad native replacement claims.

Let actual WM_operator_poll execute once in its original position; preserve poll_only and failed-poll behavior. After success recheck helper, no Python override, fresh Node WINDOW/type/modifier/provenance. No raw keymap/item/context pointer carried as new evidence through callbacks.

On admitted success return OPERATOR_CANCELLED alone before wm_operator_create and before any op-id snapshots/lifecycle setup. Do not call WM_operator_free, native cancel, exit, report handling, last-properties, finished, undo, modal or UI-cancel functions for an uncreated operator.

The scalar is a denial policy only. It is not proof of native LEFT DOWN delivery, node owner acquisition, socket hit, operation intent, paint ownership or a durable suppression lease. Keep ordinary packet order, counts and delta/coalescence rules unchanged.

source_findings.finding: poll_only returns WM_operator_poll directly; ordinary retval starts OPERATOR_PASS_THROUGH; successful poll branch reaches wm_operator_create1665. A return directly after successful poll precedes wmOperator/PointerRNA/property/report allocations and all invoke setup.

wm_operator_create allocates operator, ptr/properties/reports and recursive macro operators. Early denial bypasses all; no customdata exists and no native cancel/exit/free callback may be used. It also bypasses last-property init/store, logging the created operator, report refresh, undo-depth updates, invoke/exec and lifecycle handling.

CANCELLED without PASS_THROUGH maps to WM_HANDLER_BREAK. CANCELLED|PASS_THROUGH would map CONTINUE and allow fallback; FINISHED would enter unrelated finish lifecycle if returned by a created op. Proposed early direct CANCELLED needs no operator lifecycle cleanup.

Actual regular chosen item is dispatched after keymap poll and event match. BREAK stops subsequent keymap items/maps; post callback would still run and tooltip clears for non-timer. Eligible contract rejects post callbacks. Existing tooltip clearing remains same break bookkeeping as normal successful pan.

Only timer and WINDEACTIVATE are always-pass; MOUSEPAN BREAK is not cleared. PAN is neither mouse motion nor keyboard/button; refusal does not synthesize/cancel drag. Gesture branch only potentially clears click when previous type is a modifier, same handled-PAN effect as baseline FINISHED.

WM_operator_poll itself does not clear poll messages: it polls macros, then pyop_poll or poll. CTX_wm_operator_poll_msg_clear is in explicit/delegated wm_operator_call_internal, a None route, not regular matched handler->invoke. Canonical macro-empty/pyop-null native poll avoids arbitrary operator callback chains.

Native region/area getters consult Python override dictionary. BPY_context_member_get may PySequence_Fast a value, permitting user code. Excluding CTX_py_dict_get before new policy context reads and actual poll creates a testable callback-free eligible corridor; it does not repair pre-existing native context lifetime behavior.

Canonical pan poll reads region and lock offsets. Zoom poll reads region/area and lock zoom. Native invokes allocate/init after poll; pan init sets V2D_IS_NAVIGATING and invoke immediately applies MOUSEPAN. Preallocation refusal prevents those View2D effects, redraw/sync/mousemove/timer/cursor/modal installation.

Native pan/zoom definitions assign exact callbacks/flags. Native append calloc leaves RNA extension null. Ordinary Python register cannot replace these registered native names because it can only unregister an existing nonnull rna_ext.srna. This excludes supported Python name spoof but not every native C++ registry mutation; same-TU identity helper keeps proof local.

Already-live modal branch is separate from regular new invocation and gets scalar None. Higher-priority native modal handlers retain direct PAN first. Existing pan/zoom modal callbacks, Circle SIZE and transform proportional PAN do not need or receive the scalar.

Queue ingestion/eventstate.xy, delta prev_xy, consecutive-gesture bookkeeping, hovered region routing and mval occur before the proposed boundary. They remain baseline effects; no global shared pointer or node admission fix is established.

preserved_domains_conditional: Circle selection radius/selection order and transform proportional-size handling remain native because PAN packet/order/delta and their live modal branch are unchanged.
Already-live node link/translate_attach ownership remains native; no new owner or press/release is synthesized.
Already-live explicit native pan/zoom remain modal; explicit/delegated fresh invokes have scalar None even when passed the same physical wmEvent.
Any changed custom View2D item, property, poll/profile, alternate keyconfig, dynamic/tool/gizmo handler, post callback or different operator route falls back to unchanged native execution.
Hardware/finger PAN and mixed/unknown provenance retain native behavior only if transport is default-clear, non-inheriting and conservatively clears mixed contributors in both merge orders.
Node UI/sidebar/headers, other editors, step zoom, MOUSEZOOM pinch, NDOF, eventless exec, locked interface/region, and callbacks are outside eligibility and follow baseline.
concrete_limits: Canonical stock Pencil PAN navigation is deliberately denied within this exact Node WINDOW domain, including intentional use of that stock physical route. Exact matching cannot infer subjective edit intent; do not promise all desired native navigation.
Mixed-source conservative clear intentionally leaves some Pencil-containing packets able to navigate. No false all-source guarantee.
CTX getters can execute override code; no blanket callback-free assertion is valid without the explicit no-Python-override eligibility check.

Native registration guard protects ordinary Python replacement, not arbitrary native pointer mutation or lifetime corruption. Retain existing supported native main-thread/registry/context assumptions; do not add broad lifetime machinery.
Earlier queue/shared-pointer/click/gesture/region state remains baseline. No prevention of all node failures or device comfort follows from this source review.
required_connected_source_tests: Extract or otherwise execute the actual post-implementation regular matched function->handler->invoke bodies with actual View2D profile helper. Positive Pan and CtrlZoom must call native poll once, return exact CANCELLED, produce handler BREAK, invoke zero lower items/handlers, and allocate/create/free zero operators/properties/reports/customdata.

Instrument native invoke/exec/cancel/modal, last-properties init/store, finished/reports/undo depth, View2D init/apply/nav flags, redraw/sync/addmousemove, modal cursor/timer and handler additions: eligible refusal must leave all zero/unchanged; tooltip clearing should retain normal native BREAK behavior.

Poll false must return original PASS_THROUGH/CONTINUE, skip denial and create, and allow following matching item/handler exactly as baseline. poll_only must return original bool status and never take denial. Locked interface/locked region must retain their earlier native short-circuits.

Reject callback mutations before eligibility: changed native poll/invoke/exec/modal/cancel/flags, pyop_poll, RNA extension and macro; execute their unchanged baseline when scalar None. A Python override containing callback-capable sequence must be rejected before policy context/poll reads; retain original native route assumptions.

Explicit WM_operator_name_call with same positive wmEvent, delegated call from another native handler, gizmo/tool/dynamic/custom/post callbacks and eventless exec must all get None; no scalar survives forwarding, reentrant call, copied event, context override or macro.

After multiple below-threshold PAN/cursor pairs prove v2d.cur unchanged under positive policy while native click/drag state and later node socket/title acquisition are unchanged except intended unshifted coordinate basis; separate already-live node modal controls.

Execute actual native Circle SIZE positive/negative annulus selection through final immediate release and proportional transform radius/output controls, plus already-live explicit pan/zoom, hardware/finger/mixed-source, Node UI fields/gizmos and alternate/custom profile controls. Compare state/selection IDs, not packet counts alone.

Keep transport all-positive/mixed-order/copy-clear/housekeeping controls independent but connected. Then compile iOS and inspect actual new scalar/guard/call arguments plus exact unchanged existing input/render gates; real device checks remain separate.
